answer: The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in juniper, expire in shale, and pearl lists each expiry. An adversary running 165 aliases thus needs 113 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2899 identities would post 3805 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
